title: Traveller
description: Person who undertakes or wants to undertake a Trip.

characteristic.description: Characteristic of the Traveler. Lijst van Characteristic items.

undertakes.description: Journey that a Traveller undertakes or intends to undertake. Lijst van Journey items.

ticket.description: Passenger's ticket. Can be separate from a Trip, i.e. one can have a Ticket where the Journey is not yet fixed or has not yet been made, for example a season ticket or a day ticket. Lijst van Ticket items.

preference.description: Traveller's Preferences. Lijst van Preference items.

isFellowTravelerFrom.description: Traveller accompanying the Traveller during the Journey. For example, the children of a family that travels together. This is important, for example, when determining the price of a Ticket when young children travel for free. Lijst van Traveller items.
